quarterly_data.quarter: Astera Labs press release: Astera Labs Announces Aries 7: Industry's First PCIe 7 (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Astera Labs announced the Aries 7 PCIe 7 signal-conditioning portfolio of smart retimers, redrivers, cable modules, optical drivers and optical TIAs, which it calls the industry's first PCIe 7 portfolio spanning copper and optical interconnects; it covers chip-down designs, smart cable modules including near package optics (NPO), linear pluggable optics (LPO) and copper, extending reach from centimeters of PCB trace to 50+ meters over optical cables, and the retimers and redrivers support the OCP Signal Conditioner Standard Footprint. Aries 7 products are expected to begin sampling in Q4 2026 to select hyperscale, OEM and NPO customers, with broader availability anticipated as platforms complete qualification. AMD and Intel have each validated Aries Smart Retimers in production across their platforms from PCIe 4 through 6, and both are now collaborating with Astera Labs on the transition to PCIe 7.
quarterly_data.figure: PCIe 7; 50+ meters over optical cables; sampling Q4 2026
